p.bl: Darinn du gwaltiglich regirest/ Vnd so großmächtig gubernirest/ Noch regiert dein edel Gemüt Die Messigkeit mit ihrer gut. Was kündt eim solchen Fürsten auff erden Löblichers zugemessen werden?

main_text.head: VERSVS FORVM.
IMPERATORI CÆSARI AVGVSTO MAXIMILIANO II. GERMA. HVNGA. BOHEM, SCLAV. REGI. ARCHIDVCI AVSTRIÆ, CLEMENTISSIMO AC FELICISSIMO PRINCIPI, S. P. Q. N. HONORIS AC REVERENTIÆ ERGO POSVIT.
VERSVS ARCEM.

p.i: EN, regina avium pennis nigrantibus alas Explicat, & geminum tollit ad astra caput. Sic tua Majestas, tua gloria, Cæsar, Olympum Compleat, & Solis pulset utramq; domum.

main_text.head: SVPRA IMAGINEM IVSTITIÆ, VERSVS FORUM.
main_text.p: SIc commune bonum, Cæsar, sic jura tueris, Pro merito ut quivis, te tribuente, ferat. Iustus es, Austriaco digna est hæc sanguine virtus, Hoc Pater, hoc Patruus nomine magnus erat.

page.notes: The running head is printed with ornaments (daggers/plus signs) which are omitted. The title page dedication is set in capitals with an underlined Q in "S. P. Q. N." The black letter stanza is printed in German with long s. The Latin verse initial "E" is a large woodcut initial joined to "N,". The Latin stanzas use italic type. The Latin verse of the second stanza has no line ends marked in the printed text other than line breaks, which are rendered here as spaces.
